## Scope

- [ ] This PR represents one logical milestone.
- [ ] Unrelated changes are excluded.
- [ ] Website architecture remains plain HTML/CSS/vanilla JS unless an approved milestone explicitly changes it.

## Review

- [ ] Exact head SHA reviewed before merge.
- [ ] Changed-file scope reviewed.
- [ ] Security impact considered.
- [ ] No secrets or credentials added.
- [ ] No unsupported certification/compliance claims added.
- [ ] README / durable AI state updated when the milestone changes project status.

## Merge

Preferred: squash merge with expected-head protection. Human approval is not mandatory unless a future governance decision explicitly requires it.
